history.message: Hello 👋! Welcome to TradeXora Live Support Desk. How can I assist you with your deposits, withdrawals, or trading account today?

🏦 **Bank Withdrawal Information:**

• **Minimum Withdrawal:** ₹200 (100% unlocked balance)
• **Processing Time:** 15 to 30 minutes via direct IMPS
• **Gateway Fee:** 4% bank processing fee
• Simply enter your Account Holder Name, Bank Account Number, and IFSC Code on the Withdraw screen.
